title: Rongorongo and Nazca lines as depictions of plasma discharges

tellings.quote: that when they were in uh Easter Island um his wife Katie they were looking at this what was thought to be a writing called rango rango

plain: Matt LaCroix, a writer about lost ancient civilizations, passes on what a researcher named Robert Schoch told him about a trip to Easter Island with his wife Katie. They looked at rongorongo, carved markings there long thought to be a form of writing, and the idea he relays is that these symbols, like the Nazca lines, giant drawings scratched into the ground in Peru, show plasma discharges, huge glowing electrical shapes in the sky. If so, ancient people may have been recording something dramatic they saw overhead.
